title: Anna at the Shop
text:
Anna goes to the shop on Saturday. She needs milk, bread, and apples. The shop is near her house. She has a shopping list in her hand.

At the checkout, Anna pays for the food. She uses a card because she has no cash. The apples are red and cheap. Then she walks home with her bags.

Why does Anna have a shopping list?

questions.text: Why does Anna go to the shop near her house?
options: Because it is close and easy
Because it is open at night

paragraph_translations: Anna va a la tienda el sábado. Necesita leche, pan y manzanas. La tienda está cerca de su casa. Tiene una lista de compras en la mano.
En la caja, Anna paga la comida. Ella usa una tarjeta porque no tiene efectivo. Las manzanas son rojas y baratas. Luego camina a casa con sus bolsas.
